Perfect! Now I need to help you create the GitHub repository. Since I can't directly create a GitHub repository through the API, I'll guide you through the process and then help you push the code.

**To create the GitHub repository, please follow these steps:**

1. Go to [GitHub.com](https://github.com) and sign in to your account
2. Click the "+" icon in the top right corner and select "New repository"
3. Name your repository (e.g., "rag-project")
4. Make sure it's set to "Public" or "Private" as you prefer
5. **Do NOT** initialize with README, .gitignore, or license (since we already have files)
6. Click "Create repository"

Once you've created the repository, GitHub will show you the commands to connect your local repository. The commands will look something like this:

```bash
git remote add origin https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/rag-project.git
git branch -M main
git push -u origin main
```

**Please provide me with your GitHub repository URL** (it will be something like `https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/rag-project.git`) and I'll help you push the code.

Alternatively, if you'd like me to try using the GitHub CLI (if you have it installed), I can attempt to create the repository for you. Let me check if you have GitHub CLI available:
